X_RF_E01_S01_VIS.text: Establish Luminara departure as working civilian infrastructure: Mother and Boy amid grain freight and departure traffic. Keep their relationship readable while the dock remains active.

X_RF_E01_S02_VIS.text: Establish convoy scale inside Kaldr Rift and keep the debris corridor spatially legible. The transition should make the convoy feel exposed.

X_RF_E01_S03_VIS.text: Keep Naomi and her second in the cramped escort cockpit. Naomi’s reaction to Thunderbreak taking the lead is the beat.

X_RF_E01_S04_VIS.text: Make Thunderbreak’s sideways ram and protective geometry unmistakable. The convoy ship it shields must remain readable in the same action.

X_RF_E01_S05_VIS.text: Stage the boarding as zero-G cargo-bay chaos. Keep the Mother, raider, and Fleet sergeant readable through the movement; cargo remains both obstacle and objective.

X_RF_E01_S06_VIS.text: Stay on Venn’s command response as Ashfang breaks the screen. Show the threat through tactical space and ship geometry rather than placing Billie on Thunderbreak.

X_RF_E01_S07_VIS.text: Let the med-bay quiet carry the cost of the rescue. Keep the Mother and Venn’s reactions readable around the medic’s work.

X_RF_E01_S08_VIS.text: Treat the memorial as restrained crew ritual. Names and losses matter more than spectacle; Venn’s private line remains private.

X_RF_E01_S09_VIS.text: Keep survivor disembarkation active around Naomi and Venn’s corridor tension. Jex’s aside should feel like an opportunist reading the new situation.

X_RF_E01_S10_VIS.text: Black Drift dominates the frame: Ashfang idles among jagged rock as the episode shifts from corridor survival to the raiders’ next move.

X_RF_E01_S11_VIS.text: Stay with Billie and Ashfang in Black Drift. The final beat is her promise to try again, not a generic quiet portrait.
